summary:
Certified a fork for actual exercise under a supplied power profile, with regress and circle witnesses, and one exercise on which the same events are instruments or secondary causes depending on the profile. Rejected before certification: defining borrowed as having a source or finite grounding, which would make the source follow by definition; defining borrowed as having an actual lender, which erases secondary causes and makes the moved-mover reading trivially true; letting an empty record lend, which counts a power as borrowed from nobody; letting a merely live unexercised record lend at the actual scenario. Rejected as overreach: treating retained power as underived, since it says nothing of how the power was got; treating a self-exercising source as explaining its exercise, since a finite source with essential power has an exercise that does not occur at every allowed scenario. The moved-mover reading is refuted on one fixed model, not as a claim about real agents, and is not identified with the attributed statement. Actual productive exercise, which profile holds of real agents, adequacy and motion-to-existence remain OPEN; rivals rejecting Supply or profiles are not refuted. No source claim was added. Findings in docs/notes/borrowed-exercise-741.md. No root premise change. Vocabulary audit for #1659 and #1652 at main 91bcc8dbaef83166c09fbd30e09586764438e191: preserved all five capacity/exercise sense identities; linked actual transmission to the existing Profile field with explicit primitive meaning, and corrected endpoint existence to require Coherent. Reused the borrowed-power profile for exercise, exercised, capacity and power lexicon tracing. Capacity remains a supplied parameter without a common named declaration: the event/scenario and bearer/world consumers require an explicit interpretation map, not an alias to Borrowed or a stronger IntendedProfile. Exact direct consumer inventory, claim/type sweep, rejected substitutions and next adapter test persist in docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md under Capacity and exercise vocabulary audit. No theorem, source attribution, philosophical defeat or root discharge is added. No substantive objection to the distinctions was identified; the existing source-free rival remains unresolved. Local Lean dependencies and build seed are absent, so generated formal status and affected binding are deferred to coordinator integration. Authorized indexed-interface continuation: CapacityInterface retains situation, bearer and specified respect as explicit indices. Exact factorization holds precisely under FiberAgreement for every pair mapped to those same indices; retaining event identity gives a lossless fallback without that assumption. Thin bearer-profile and actual BorrowedExercise/root-consumer adapters preserve their formulas, with PowerRequired separate and capOccurs/capAll/PowerOmission unchanged. Boolean event and scenario collision controls witness information loss, not a new philosophical defeat. The new certificate passes focused Lean, one-result binding, Comparator and NanoDa under the standard classical axioms. Capacity remains a primitive with explicit meaning and application obligations; the actual root premises and shared consumers are unchanged. The coordinator-provided warm seed resolved the earlier build-readiness gap. The exercise entry loses both broad disambiguation links as required by independent review; its four direct meanings remain. Full proposed outcome and self-sweep are in docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md under Indexed capacity adapter. Independent challenge of the new adapter and final integration checks remain pending. Selected Cogito consumer continuation (2026-11-17): the selected-capacity sibling argument explicitly instantiates the original inhabitedFromPower with bearerProfile p intellectualEffect and retains all six original premise statements. The sibling result is an instantiation, not a new warrant or discharge. The transport/control result gives selected-world formula transport under an explicit mapping and one-world/one-bearer/one-episode controls for omitted exercise-to-capacity and mixed-profile mapping. A distinct non-intellectual respect remains possessed in both controls. The interpreted intellectual effect is understanding or judging, not mandatory production of a separate object; suitable conditions and actual applicability remain OPEN. Focused direct Lean compilation reuses parent warm imports; both result bindings match (2 bound, 0 mismatch), but an unrelated Maximal/Maximum sense-alias report exits nonzero. Comparator cannot build in the unprepared local worktree and attempts a blocked dependency fetch; Comparator/NanoDa, prepared-worktree affected gates, independent semantic challenge and final CI remain pending. Computed frontier-diff from d69634db451aabb99ba0be7f2c231747169a478f is no change. Complete proposed outcome, precise models, self-sweep, root connection and reopening conditions are appended to docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md. No original consumer, shared definition, source attribution, allowlist, generated import or q44/FirstPrincipleRoles file changed.

Curation pass 2, lane D batch 4 (#2103, 2026-11-27). d26f85e9 remains unplaced. The collapsed event and scenario rows each falsify `∃ p, Corresponds interface capacity p`: the projection assigns the same indices to two entries on which capacity differs. The separated-respect row preserves the event distinction and constructs the correspondence. The root-route power premises do not register these interface correspondences.
